title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Temporary of Permanent Withdrawal from Studies
Website:
https://students.wlu.ca/registration-and-finances/enrolment-services/withdrawing.html
For both temporary and permanent withdraws,
students
must drop their courses using LORIS (if applicable).
If unable to use LORIS, complete the Drop Course Request Form. Students who leave the university without
dropping form all courses on LORIS will have each of the applicable course grades recorded and will not be
eligible for any refund of fees. The policy outlined under
Adding or Dropping from Courses
applies.
Students holding scholarships or loans must bear responsibility for meeting obligations in returning or
repaying funds.
Temporary Withdrawals
A student requesting a temporary withdraw should consult the Withdrawing from Laurier website for process
and forms:
https://students.wlu.ca/registration-and-finances/enrolment-services/withdrawing.html
Permanent Withdrawals
A student requesting to permanently withdraw from full-time studies or part-time studies at Laurier can
complete the
Withdrawal Form
.
